payload.description:
As a platform integrator, I want to deploy the asynchronous scoring service from client-neutral Plexus infrastructure components, so that integrations provide only their own runtime behavior and configuration.

Feature: Reusable asynchronous scoring infrastructure

Scenario: Deploy a client-neutral scoring platform
  Given an integrator supplies explicit names, networking configuration, immutable runtime images, handlers, permissions, and worker definitions
  When the Plexus infrastructure stacks are synthesized
  Then they provision the network, scoring, integration hosting, scheduled worker hosting, operations, artifact repositories, and observability resources
  And no client-specific behavior or values are embedded in Plexus

Scenario: Deploy the validated score processor image
  Given an integrator supplies an immutable score processor image URI by digest
  When the asynchronous scoring stack is synthesized and deployed
  Then that exact image URI is assigned to the score processor function
  And no mutable parameter is resolved later during deployment

Scenario: Preserve existing Plexus workloads
  Given existing Plexus scoring workloads use legacy infrastructure entry points
  When the reusable service components are added
  Then those existing entry points and deployments remain unchanged
payload.title: Consumers deploy a complete scoring substrate from reusable components
